title: Visual Stimulation for Decoding Ambiguous Visual Scenes
text:
Three experimental axes

Spatial ambiguity — natural images at various degrees of ambiguity (low → high)
Feature precision — grating orientation in a narrow range
Temporal information — increasing temporal jitters


This is a calibration protocol: the aim is to span the decoding difficulty space, not to test a single hypothesis. The three axes can then be combined factorialy in the main experiments.

title: Visual Stimulation for Decoding Ambiguous Visual Scenes
text:
Protocol

Natural image set varied at multiple ambiguity levels
morphing approach: continuous interpolation between two natural scenes
ambiguity quantified per image (to be defined: categorical distance metric)

title: Visual Stimulation for Decoding Ambiguous Visual Scenes

Protocol

drifting gratings, orientation within a narrow range around the trained orientation
probes the precision of orientation decoding when the alternatives are close together

title: Visual Stimulation for Decoding Ambiguous Visual Scenes
text:
Protocol

same nominal stimulus, temporal jitter varied parametrically
tests how decoding relies on temporal precision vs. averaged rate codes
